theme_and_archetype.reasoning: Fits the premium fintech requirement perfectly. Focuses on clear typography, structural grayscale, and high-contrast text against clean backgrounds. This is infused with the brand's Sky/Deep Blue palette to evoke both authority and modern digital finance while feeling highly trustworthy.

rules: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for headings.
Ensure heading line-height is tight (leading-tight) and body is relaxed (leading-relaxed).
Use text-3xl to text-4xl max for main screen headers in mobile view.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy: Use 2-3x more spacing. Apply p-4 to p-6 padding on screen containers.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento Grid Mode B ('Control Room' Grid) for widgets (Investments, Quick Actions) using Tailwind grid-cols-2 or grid-cols-4 for dense but structured icon grids.
spacing_and_layout.navigation: Bottom tab bar with glassmorphism and active state indicators.
spacing_and_layout.safe_area: Ensure SafeAreaView is utilized to prevent content from going under screen notches or home indicators.

surface_strategies.headers: Crystal Glass - Use backdrop-blur-xl with light bg opacity (e.g., bg-white/70) and a delicate 1px bottom border.
surface_strategies.cards: Subtle Neumorphism or flat with 1px subtle border. In light mode: bg-white with shadow-sm and border-slate-100.
surface_strategies.modals: Bottom sheet style modals for quick actions, with heavy rounded-t-3xl corners and a top drag handle indicator.

inputs.default: bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-slate-900 focus:border-[#38BDF8]

icons.style: stroke-width 2, color matched to text or primary action.

animations.transitions: Use react-native-reanimated for smooth layout transitions.
animations.interactions: Scale down to 0.95 on press (Pressable with animated style). Use gentle glassmorphism opacity fades on scroll headers.

home_dashboard.layout: Header (User Profile + Notification Bell), Quick Actions Grid (8 icons: Send, Add, Scan, UPI, Bills, etc.), Financial Overview Bento Card (Total balance, portfolio value), Trending Investments horizontal list.

wallet.layout: Large balance display centered, Add/Withdraw CTAs below. List of recent transactions categorized by debits/credits.

investments.layout: Portfolio chart line graph, Asset allocation breakdown (Mutual funds, Stocks, Gold, FDs), SIP quick setup.

travel.layout: Search bar, category tabs (Flights, Hotels, Bus, Train), Popular destinations carousel with immersive background images.

profile.layout: User avatar, KYC status badge, Theme toggle, linked banks list, Referral Program block.

auth.layout: Clean login, prominent Bull Logo, Welcome text. Login via biometrics massive CTA.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute equivalent. In React Native, use the `testID` prop.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the Expo React Native app using NativeWind (Tailwind for RN) for styling.
Implement bottom tab navigation using Expo Router.
CRITICAL: Write all code in .js files, NOT .tsx files.
CRITICAL: Use the testID prop on all components to satisfy the 'data-testid' requirement for automated testing in React Native.
Do NOT use raw text strings outside of <Text> components.
Use safe area insets (SafeAreaView or react-native-safe-area-context) properly.
Apply the provided image URLs exclusively for banners, placeholders, and the main logo.
